.github/workflows/reproducibility.yml.origin: The single reproducibility gate: a pinned interpreter, a locked dependency graph, pinned seeds and single-threaded BLAS regenerate the published numbers and the results-of-record file byte for byte.
.github/workflows/reproducibility.yml.protects: A change that moves a reported number, the RNG stream order, or the serialised results of record without saying so; a dependency or interpreter drift that would quietly change a decomposition.
.github/workflows/reproducibility.yml.consumer: Pull-request admission (the job is the required check) and the daqt-server CI health monitor, which reads the default-branch verdict.
.github/workflows/reproducibility.yml.falsifier: tests/test_ci_assurance_workflow.py pins the job's shape (hosted on a pinned image, bounded, read-only, pinned actions, main never cancelled); the workflow's own byte-identical regeneration step fails on any drift in the record.
.github/workflows/reproducibility.yml.rollback: git revert of the workflow change; the ruleset requiring the check is removed with the provider API if the job has to be withdrawn.
